ig_caption:
The LLM provider went down. Our users saw a stack trace. 😬

AI wrote this chatbot:
⚠️ call the model
⚠️ if anything fails, send the raw error straight back to the user (file paths, code, library names: HTTP 500)
⚠️ and nobody on the team knew: no alert, no number

The fix:
✅ catch the failure
✅ give users a calm fallback answer
✅ count every failure (llm_errors), so monitoring can wake someone up

Same outage → a polite answer for users, and a number the team can alert on.

AI is just another dependency. Plan for the day it's down.

What do YOUR users see when the model is down? 👇 Follow for more fixes like this.

#genai #llm #sre #devops #ai
yt_title: LLM API down? Don't show users a stack trace #genai #sre
yt_description:
Demo (local Python, the "LLM provider" is a stand-in server we stop to simulate an outage):
- AI-style handler returns traceback.format_exc() with HTTP 500, so users see internals and the team sees nothing
- fix: catch the failure, return a fallback answer, increment an llm_errors counter exposed on /metrics for alerting

AI is just another dependency: plan for the day it's down.

Part of the "AI App to Production" journey: one AI chatbot from laptop to production.

#genai #llm #sre #observability #devops
